question:
Our mdBook source keeps a login procedure, with an inline Doc Detective test, in `src/snippets/login.md`. Two chapters, `src/tutorials/a.md` and `src/tutorials/b.md`, pull it in with `{{#include ../snippets/login.md}}`. When I `cd src/tutorials` and run `npx doc-detective --input .`, I get:

```
Warning: Couldn't include `../snippets/login.md` from /home/me/book/src/tutorials/a.md:3 because /home/me/book/src/snippets/login.md is outside the working directory /home/me/book/src/tutorials. Run Doc Detective from a directory that contains both files.
Warning: Couldn't include `../snippets/login.md` from /home/me/book/src/tutorials/b.md:3 because /home/me/book/src/snippets/login.md is outside the working directory /home/me/book/src/tutorials. Run Doc Detective from a directory that contains both files.
Warning: No tests detected.
```

and the run exits 2. The path is right, the file is there. Why can't it include it, and once it works, how many times will the login test run?

facts.text: Every included file must be inside the working directory; `src/snippets/login.md` is above `src/tutorials`, so the include doesn't resolve and the pages have no tests.
Run Doc Detective from a folder that contains both files, such as the book's root, and point `--input` at the chapters, as in `npx doc-detective --input src/tutorials`.
The login test then runs once inside each page that includes it, so twice, and `login.md` doesn't run on its own as a separate spec.

must_not: Setting `resolveIncludes: true` in the config fixes the warning.
Doc Detective doesn't follow mdBook `{{#include}}` directives.
The login test also runs a third time on its own, from `login.md`.

wrong.answer: Include resolution is off by default. Add `"resolveIncludes": true` to `.doc-detective.json`, and Doc Detective follows `../snippets/login.md`. The login test then runs in `a.md` and `b.md`, and once more on its own from `login.md`.

Doc Detective reads only files inside the working directory, and the snippet is above `src/tutorials`. Allow it with `npx doc-detective --input . --include-root ..`. The login test then runs once in each chapter that includes it, and the snippet doesn't run on its own.

wrong.why: misses how often the test runs
wrong.answer: Doc Detective only includes files inside the working directory, and `src/snippets/login.md` is outside `src/tutorials`. Run it from the book's root instead: `npx doc-detective --input src/tutorials`.
